title: Compare A2A agent card schema (.well-known/agent-card.json) with SEP-2127 Server Card. Evaluate dual-format generation: one Build() call producing both formats. Reference: https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/ and existing servercard/attach.go
close_reason: Closed 26-04-2026 as not-now. User judged A2A protocol spec (a2a-protocol.org) not mature enough to invest in dual-format generation. SEP-2127 Server Card is the live target; A2A is in active spec churn. Re-open when A2A reaches a stable major version OR when a downstream consumer asks for A2A-format output.

title: SEP-2127 ecosystem check: production feedback, interop, scope risk, watch-target change
description:
Sifted PR #2127 on 21-07-2026. Library at v0.3.0, last commit 04-05-2026. Four maintenance inputs; none requires a code change yet.

1. READ b-gutman's production report (PR #2127 comment, 05-06-2026). Only production-scale deployment feedback in the thread: gateway.pipeworx.io/.well-known/mcp-server-card plus per-instance /.well-known/mcp-server-card/{pack-slug} across 755 packs. Validates two design choices worth having confirmed: the server.json-subset shape needed NO new metadata sourcing (data already in hand), and path collision with existing .well-known/oauth-* routes was a non-issue thanks to the mcp-server-card segment. Also flags a gap they solved via _meta: a "use this if you don't know what to pick" default pointer for multi-server hosts. WellKnownPathFor is the surface that would express per-instance paths.

2. TEST interop with wong2/mcp-server-detector (https://github.com/wong2/mcp-server-detector, posted 09-05-2026). First client-side implementation in the wild: a browser extension that discovers server cards while browsing. If it parses cards this library emits, that is free validation and a README line. If it does not, better to find the bug than to have it filed.

3. TRACK AS OPEN RISK, not a feature request: YE-YI7's scope question (03-06 and 06-06-2026, unanswered by the authors). Is value/economic metadata (pricing, quality benchmarks, SLA, payment) eventually in-card, or deliberately out of scope and resolved in AI Catalog above the card? If the WG puts it in-card, that is a schema addition here.

4. CHANGE THE WATCH TARGET. Two scope-reduction commits already tracked a moving Draft (remove capabilities/requires/authentication; remove MCP resource endpoint per PR #2443). The target has stopped moving: SEP open since 21-01-2026, still Draft; sep-automation-bot posted 14-day maintainer-inactivity nags at @dsp-ant on 18-05 and 01-06, neither answered in-thread; last substantive human comment 06-06-2026. Watch modelcontextprotocol/experimental-ext-server-card instead, where schema.ts is the normative source of truth and docs/discovery.md holds the discovery mechanics. Cheaper signal than the SEP PR.

Downstream symptom already documented in this repo's README and still true: the mandated $schema URL https://static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/v1/server-card.schema.json returns 404, schema hosting pending SEP merge.

DEFERRED (decided 21-07-2026, out of scope here): proposing .well-known/mcp-server-card as an agent-readiness item to The Website Specification. Gated on the SEP actually moving; proposing a path whose defining spec is stalled and whose $schema 404s is proposing a standard that is not one yet.

NOTE: created via durable-JSONL fallback (rules/beads-tooling.md rule 3) because the local Dolt DB was absent while issues.jsonl and metadata.json survived. Re-import with `bd import .beads/issues.jsonl --dedup` when the DB is restored.
